Test_Description: Basic MIPI DSI DBI write test with single descriptor DMA transfer. Configures PHY with 4 lanes (n_lanes=3), sets up DBI interface in command mode, loads random pixel data (40 pixels) and write_memory_start command into SRAM, then triggers DMA channels (CH0 for data, CH1 for command) via DMAC debug interface. Verifies completion via DMAC interrupt handling at subsystem level.
Step_Description: Enable GIC IRQ for DSI interrupt
Field_Description: GIC interrupt for DSI_INTR_NO is enabled to allow interrupt-driven DMA completion detection

Step_Description: Enable DMAC interrupts for CH0 and CH1
Field_Description: This field selects which events can generate an IRQ
Expected_Behavior: Bits [1:0] set to 1 enabling IRQ for event 0 (CH0) and event 1 (CH1)

Step_Description: Enable GDMA interrupt at DSI subsystem level
Field_Description: Enable bit for GDMA interrupt at subsystem level
Expected_Behavior: GDMA interrupt is enabled at the DSI subsystem level

Step_Description: Configure PHY_IF_CFG - set n_lanes=3 and phy_stop_wait_time=0x40
Field_Description: Configures the number of active data lanes: 3 means 4 lanes
Minimum time PHY needs to stay in StopState before requesting HS transmission
Packet handling configuration: EoTp TX/RX, BTA, ECC, CRC enables
Expected_Behavior: 0x3D = 0b00111101: eotp_tx_en=1, eotp_rx_en=0, bta_en=1, ecc_rx_en=1, crc_rx_en=1, eotp_tx_lp_en=1

Field_Description: TX Escape clock division and Timeout clock division
DBI/DPI enable control: 0=DBI mode
Expected_Behavior: DPI disabled (DBI mode selected) by writing 0

Field_Description: PHY initialization sequence executed (PHY_RSTZ, clock lane setup, PLL lock wait)

Step_Description: Configure DBI parameters and call dbi_config()
Field_Description: Configures DBI: vcid=3, lut_size=1, out_dbi_conf=0xB, in_dbi_conf=0, partitioning_en=1, wr_cmd_size=computed, allowed_cmd_size=7, tear_fx_en=1, generic_vc_id=2
Expected_Behavior: DBI interface fully configured for DCS write memory operation

Step_Description: Setup DMA descriptors and load random data + write command into SRAM
Field_Description: DMA CH0 descriptor: SAR=RAM_BASE+0x10000 (data), DAR=0x10000000000; CH1 descriptor: SAR=RAM_BASE+0x0000 (cmd), DAR=0x10000008000
Expected_Behavior: DMA descriptors programmed at RAM_BASE+0x3F000 (CH0) and RAM_BASE+0x3F800 (CH1)

Step_Description: Start DMA CH0 via DMAC debug interface
Field_Description: Debug instruction byte 0 and 1 for DMAGO on CH0
Debug instruction bytes 2-5 containing the program start address
Execute the instruction previously loaded in DBGINST0/1
Expected_Behavior: DMA CH0 starts executing from descriptor address

Step_Description: Start DMA CH1 via DMAC debug interface
Field_Description: Debug instruction byte 0 and 1 for DMAGO on CH1
Debug instruction bytes 2-5 containing the program start address
Execute the instruction previously loaded in DBGINST0/1
Expected_Behavior: DMA CH1 starts executing from descriptor address

Step_Description: Wait for both DMA channels to complete (interrupt-driven)
Field_Description: Wait until int_pend1 becomes 0 (both CH0 and CH1 interrupts received and cleared)

Step_Description: ISR: Read DSI subsystem interrupt mask status
Field_Description: Masked interrupt status for GDMA
Expected_Behavior: Check if GDMA interrupt is the source (bit1=MIPI_DSI_SUBSYS_INTERRUPT_MASK_GDMA_INTR)

Step_Description: ISR: Read DMAC masked interrupt status
Field_Description: Masked interrupt status of the DMA channels
Expected_Behavior: Non-zero value indicates which channel(s) completed

Field_Description: Write to clear the corresponding channel interrupt
Expected_Behavior: DMAC interrupt for completed channel(s) cleared

Field_Description: Raw interrupt status / clear register
GIC interrupt cleared for DSI_INTR_NO
Test completes; err0=0 means PASS, err0>0 means FAIL (unexpected interrupts detected)

Test_Description: DBI random payload stress test. Runs 10 iterations with randomized pixel counts (multiples of 8, up to 8192). Each iteration reconfigures DBI wr_cmd_size based on random pixel count, programs DMA descriptors, loads random data and write_memory_start command, triggers DMA via debug interface, polls DMAC INTMIS for both channel completion (0x3), clears interrupts, and waits. Tests DBI data path robustness with varying payload sizes.
Step_Description: Configure PHY_IF_CFG - set n_lanes=3 and phy_stop_wait_time=0x40
Field_Description: Configures the number of active data lanes
Minimum time PHY needs to stay in StopState before requesting HS transmission
Packet handling configuration
TX Escape clock division and Timeout clock division
DBI/DPI enable control
PHY initialization sequence executed

Step_Description: Configure DBI parameters (partitioning_en=0; allowed_cmd_size=0x25) and call dbi_config()
Field_Description: DBI config: vcid=3, lut_size=1, out_dbi_conf=0xB, in_dbi_conf=0, partitioning_en=0 (auto partitioning by HW), allowed_cmd_size=0x25, tear_fx_en=1, generic_vc_id=2
Expected_Behavior: DBI interface configured; auto-partitioning enabled since partitioning_en=0

Step_Description: Enable DMAC interrupts for CH0 and CH1
Field_Description: Selects which events can generate an IRQ
Expected_Behavior: Bits [1:0]=1 enabling IRQ for CH0 and CH1 events

Step_Description: [LOOP i=0..9] Generate random pixel count, recompute wr_cmd_size/num_bytes, reconfigure DBI
Field_Description: DCS write memory command size reconfigured each iteration

Step_Description: [LOOP] Setup DMA descriptors, load random data and write command
Field_Description: CH0: SAR=RAM_BASE+0x10000, DAR=0x10000000000, len=num_bytes (ceil to 8-byte aligned); CH1: SAR=RAM_BASE+0x0000, DAR=0x10000008000, len=4
Expected_Behavior: DMA descriptors at RAM_BASE+0x3F000 (CH0) and RAM_BASE+0x3F800 (CH1)

Field_Description: DMAGO instruction for CH0
Program start address for CH0
Execute debug instruction
DMAGO instruction for CH1
Program start address for CH1
Execute debug instruction

Step_Description: [LOOP] Poll DMAC INTMIS until both channels complete
Field_Description: Masked interrupt status
Expected_Behavior: Poll until rd_data==0x3 (both CH0 and CH1 events signaled)

Field_Description: Write to clear channel interrupts
Expected_Behavior: Both CH0 and CH1 interrupts cleared

Field_Description: Wait 100000 cycles for DSI link to complete packet transmission
Test completes with PASS (err=0); all 10 random payload iterations succeeded
